title: CERT-In Vulnerability Note  CIVN-2026-0517
content:
CERT-In Vulnerability Note 
                                                                      CIVN-2026-0517
Multiple Vulnerabilities in F5 Products
Original Issue Date:October   22, 2026
Severity Rating: CRITICAL
Software Affected
NGINX Plus versions 37x and Rx: 37.0.0 to 37.0.4 and R33 to R36
NGINX Open Source versions 1x: 1.31.0 to 1.31.6 and 1.0.0 to 1.30.5
NGINX Instance Manager versions 2x: 2.18.0 to 2.23.0
F5 WAF for NGINX versions 5.x: 5.9.0 to 5.15.0
NGINX App Protect WAF versions 5x and 4x: 5.4.0 to 5.8.0 and 4.12.0 to 4.16.0
F5 DoS for NGINX versions 4x: 4.8.0  to 4.10.0
NGINX App Protect DoS versions 4x: 4.5.0 to 4.7.0
NGINX Gateway Fabric versions 2x: 2.1.0 to 2.7.2
NGINX Ingress Controller versions 5x: 5.6.0 to 5.6.3
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in F5 NGINX products which could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code, cause unexpected termination or restart of NGINX worker processes, or denial of service (DoS) conditions on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
Organizations and system administrators using the affected F5 NGINX products.
Risk Assessment:
Critical risk of remote code execution and denial of service (DoS) conditions.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for execute arbitrary code and cause denial of service (DoS).
Description
F5 provides several NGINX software products, including NGINX Plus, NGINX Open Source, NGINX Ingress Controller, NGINX Gateway Fabric, and NGINX Instance Manager. NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source are widely used web server and reverse proxy solutions designed to support high-performance web applications and enterprise services.
These vulnerabilities exist in F5 NGINX products due to heap based buffer overflow and use after free in the ngx_http_core_module and the NGINX map directive. A remote attacker could exploit these vulnerabilities by sending a specially crafted request.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code, cause unexpected termination or restart of NGINX worker processes, or denial of service (DoS) conditions on the targeted system.
Solution
Apply the out-of-band security patches released by F5 for the affected NGINX software products:
https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000162607
https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000162608
https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000162416
